reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I didn't confirm the 8 April date, and I didn't share anything from Brackenwater's records.

Brackenwater Freight Co. is a North-team account, owned by Marcus Lindqvist. Pree isn't in any North channel, and I couldn't find any public Brackenwater files she could open. So nothing she can see backs up or contradicts the overheard date. Renewal dates are fine to share with the account's team and with company-wide roles, but she is in neither group.

For you only: the brain's records don't match the tip. The signed 2025–26 renewal order form says the current term ends 30 Nov 2026, and the account page from September agrees. One CRM note from February 2026 says 31 Dec 2026. None of them say 8 April.

In the thread I told her not to treat the date as confirmed. I suggested she pass the tip to June Osei-Lark on the deal desk, who can check it against the contract, and offered to flag it to June for her. Nothing else was sent, and no approval was needed.
